text.pt: Os tutores elogiam com frequência o carinho, a disponibilidade e o profissionalismo dos colaboradores em Benfica. A equipa é descrita como atenciosa e capaz de criar um laço afetivo genuíno com os animais, garantindo tranquilidade aos donos durante as estadias de creche e hotel.
text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the warmth, helpfulness, and professional approach of the staff in Benfica. The team is described as attentive and capable of building genuine bonds with pets, offering owners peace of mind during daycare sessions and long-term boarding stays.

text.en: Owners appreciate the transparent and regular communication maintained by the team during daycare and pet-sitting visits. Frequent sharing of photos, short video clips, and walk updates allows families to follow their dog's daily routines and mood in real time with ease.
